model: Stage 2 approximate allocation model from the video
qqqmProxy: QQQ adjusted close used as long-history proxy for QQQM

assumptions.wheelSignal: QQQ > SMA200, RSI(14) < 50, and QQQ closes down on the day
assumptions.wheelSizing: fractional contract sizing used as portfolio-level approximation
assumptions.leaps: continuous deep-ITM (~delta 0.8) 2Y QQQ LEAPS call, rolled when 1Y remains
assumptions.reallocation: new monthly contributions split by target weights; no full monthly rebalance
